test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose ‘No error’.

Bushfire have created havoc and exacerbated the conditions of animals in the forest.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **error is in **the part: "Bushfire have created havoc"
 
• The **correct form** should be "Bushfires have created havoc".
 
• In English, **subject-verb agreement** is a grammatical rule which states that the subject and verb must agree in number.
 
• That means, if the subject is plural, the verb must be plural.
 
• Conversely, if the **subject is singular, the verb must be singular.**
 
• In this case, **"Bushfire" **is a singular noun, but **"have" **is a plural verb, so they don't agree in number.
 
• The **sentence should be corrected by** changing "Bushfire" to the plural form "Bushfires" to match the plural verb "have".

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'Bushfires have created havoc and exacerbated the conditions of animals in the forest.'*
